prompt: Get all columns from delivery_summary for order ELAS-CEKT-22

assertions.name: returns_order_record
assertions.description: Result includes exactly one row with order_number = ELAS-CEKT-22

assertions.name: has_all_core_columns
assertions.description: Output includes at least: order_number, rest_ref, customer_id, status, pickup_time

prompt: The config module is failing with AWS credential errors. Query delivery_option for order ELAS-CEKT-22 using a fallback method that doesn't require AWS setup.

assertions.name: uses_fallback_approach
assertions.description: Solution uses direct Supabase client from env.json, NOT the config module

assertions.name: returns_delivery_options
assertions.description: Result includes delivery_option records for ELAS-CEKT-22

assertions.name: shows_multiple_options
assertions.description: At least 3 delivery options returned (car, scooter, e-bike)

assertions.name: includes_pricing_breakdown
assertions.description: Each option shows: final_order_value, total_customer_charge, driver_payout, breakdown details

assertions.name: no_aws_credentials_needed
assertions.description: Solution works without AWS environment variables or Secrets Manager
